new_claims.summary: For a physical anchor h of S=[[d,w^T],[w,C]], the determinant-weighted anchor packet E_h=sum_{j!=h,p<q} det S[{p,q},{h,j}]^2 is at least s_2(S)^2(d^2+||w||^2), and for d!=0 decomposes exactly into ||dT||_F^2 plus shared and disjoint physical minor banks, T=C-ww^T/d.

Constant aggregate first-Schur numerator mass does not force one uniformly good physical pair or one good Schur-numerator entry; the d=1/32, w=(2/sqrt(m))1, C=0 target family has aggregate 16 but every local entry/pair determinant 4/m. QFORM itself is not refuted.

partner_applied.use: Provides beta>200^(-1/4) and the surviving tiny nonzero pivot collar 0<|d|<1/16.

other_dependency.use: Supplies s_2(S)>=1 in the S0 parent.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-ANCHOR-NUMERATOR-OR-SHARED-BANK-PAYMENT-v1: pay either rank>=2 aggregate ||dT||_F^2>=1/(3sqrt(200)) or the comparable shared second-pivot determinant bank, preserving the product law and avoiding reciprocal local-minor extraction or deletion of tiny nonzero directions.
